EconomyLevel.Description: Overall Pokemon sell price economy. Strict = low prices, Fortune = very high prices. Applies to all rarity tiers proportionally.

IncubationSpeed.Description: Incubation time for all rarity tiers. Balanced = intended pacing.

BabyGrowthSpeed.Description: Baby stage duration for all rarity tiers. Balanced = intended pacing.

ShinyRate.AllowValues: VeryRare, Rare, Balanced, Common, High, VeryHigh, Guaranteed
ShinyRate.Description: Chance for eggs to hatch a Shiny Pokemon. VeryRare = 1%, Rare = 5%, Balanced = 10%, Common = 20%, High = 50%, VeryHigh = 70%, Guaranteed = every hatch is Shiny!

EvolutionHearts.Description: Hearts of friendship needed for a Pokemon to reach its final evolution (1 heart = 200 friendship).

EggLayingRate.Description: Daily chance for a high-friendship Pokemon to produce its own egg. Never disables renewable eggs entirely.

CommunityCenter.Description: How the Community Center bundles handle Pokemon products. pokemon: the Animal and Dye bundles ask for Pokemon milk, wool, eggs and feather instead of the vanilla ones, so you never need a chicken. difficile: the same, but every item must be gold quality and the Animal bundle wants all six. off: the bundles are left untouched, for players who use another Community Center mod.
